mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE status = 1) AS onSaleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 1) AS totalTradeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 'seller') AS sellerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite) AS totalFavoriteCount, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, g.create_time, o.create_time)), 1), 0) FROM orders o JOIN goods g ON g.goods_id = o.goods_id WHERE o.order_status = 1) AS avgTradeDays
SELECT DISTINCT g.campus FROM goods g WHERE g.status = 1 AND g.campus IS NOT NULL AND g.campus != '' ORDER BY g.campus ASC
